title: Fallout 76 - Debunker News - Head Hunts

author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
Something has reactivated the military research base known as Camp Jefferson. There you find yourself trapped - unarmed, poisoned, and under the effect of a hallucination inducing FEV strain. You'll need to gather equipment, solve puzzles, and fight your way through the secret facility as you race to find a cure.

Featuring:
- Return of the original voice actors – Courtenay Taylor and Brian T. Delaney
- Escape room style dungeon loaded with puzzles and lore
- Chance to connect with the mind's eye version of your spouse
- New equipment (weapon, outfit, armor set)

(Seek out a Gutsy robot in the market area of Diamond City to begin the quest "Fever Dreams”.)

FEVer Dreams by Kinggath Creations is presented by Bethesda Game Studios.

ESRB RATING: Mature with Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Strong Language, and Use of Drugs
